title: Monitoring cell fate in 3D organotypic human squamous epithelial cultures
protocol: Generate GFP and cell modification retroviruses and/or lentiviruses.
Identify retroviral or lentiviral vectors of interest.
Transfect suitable 293T cells, e.g., Lenti-X 293T (recommended passage: 10 or lower).
Seed 2.5 × 10^6 293T cells into one 6 cm tissue culture dish.
Let cells settle overnight.
Add 12 μL of Trans-IT 293 to 400 μL of Opti-MEM.
Pipette to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Add 2 μg of lentiviral vector, 1 μg of psPAX2, and 1 μg of pMD2.G to each lentiviral transfection mix.
Pipette to mix the lentiviral transfection components.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Add 2 μg of retroviral vector, 1 μg of pUMVC, and 1 μg of pCMV-VSV-G to each retroviral transduction mix.
Pipette to mix the retroviral transduction components.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Add one lentiviral transfection mix dropwise to a 6 cm plate of 293T cells.
Swirl the plate to ensure thorough mixing.
Incubate the plate for 24 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Refed the 6 cm plates after incubation.
Aspirate the supernatant from each 6 cm plate.
Disinfect the aspirated supernatant on each 6 cm plate.
Replace the disinfecting solution with 2 mL of Monolayer Keratinocyte Serum Free Medium in each plate.
Incubate for another 24 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Harvest lentivirus by collecting the supernatant containing viral particles.
Filter the harvested supernatant through a 0.45 μm syringe filter to remove cell debris.
Freeze aliquots of filtered supernatant at -80°C for up to one year storage.
Thaw low passage primary HFK cells (recommended passage: 3 or lower).
Use thawed primary HFK cells as soon as possible after isolation for best results.
Seed primary HFK cells in a 6 well tissue culture plate at a density of 5 × 10^4 cells per well using 2 mL of monolayer keratinocyte serum-free medium.
Include an extra well for each drug-selectable marker as a selection control.
Seed 1.5 × 10^5 HFK cells per 15 cm dish for organotypic cultures.
Add 1 mL of fresh monolayer keratinocyte serum-free media containing 16 μg/mL polybrene to each well after aspirating existing media 24 hours post-seeding.
Mix 750 μL of control or HPV18 E7 retrovirus and 250 μL of GFP lentivirus in appropriate wells.
Add 1 mL of monolayer keratinocyte serum-free media to control wells.
Swirl gently to mix the added solutions.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 2 hours.
Replace the media with fresh monolayer keratinocyte serum-free media after incubation.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Expand and select HFK cells.
Passage transduced keratinocytes 24 hours post-transduction from a single well into one 15 cm dish.
Culture doubly transduced HFK in selection media with puromycin and G418.
Culture control HFK with puromycin in one well and G418 in another well.
Refeed HFK with 18 mL of selection media every 48 hours.
Monitor the death of cells in control plates to confirm complete selection after 4-5 days for G418.
Monitor GFP transduction by fluorescence microscopy.
Confirm all doubly transduced cells are GFP positive once the selection is complete.
Thaw sufficient dermis for experiment by placing frozen aliquot in conical tube in 37°C water bath.
Pour both dermis and buffer into a 15 cm tissue culture plate.
Spread the dermis into a flat, even layer on the plate using autoclaved forceps.
Determine which side of the dermis is the basement membrane and which is dermal by visual inspection.
Cut the dermis into appropriately sized square pieces, each edge being approximately 5 mm longer than the edge of the hole in the stand.
Place pieces of dermis into individual wells of a 12-well tissue culture plate with the dermal side facing up.
Add 500 μL of HFF medium to each well.
Trypsinize and seed HFF cells from a recommended passage: 6 or lower.
Add 2 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA solution per 10 cm plate of cells for trypsinization.
Inactivate trypsin by adding equal volume of HFF medium.
Transfer cells to conical tube.
Centrifuge cells for 4 min at 290 RCF.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL fibroblast medium.
Seed 1 × 10^5 fibroblasts in 500 μL of medium on each piece of dermis.
Culture the fibroblasts at 37°C on dermis.
Replace media after 48 hours.
Check HFF density by looking at areas not covered by the dermis.
Autoclave a scalpel and two pairs of forceps.
Thaw 200 μL of Matrigel in an ice bucket overnight.
Place dermis on raft culture stands.
Stretch one fibroblast-covered piece of dermis over the hole of each stand using two pairs of forceps.
Aspirate any remaining liquid from the dermis.
Plug the bottom of the stand with Matrigel.
Pipette about 100 μL of Matrigel onto the bottom of each raft.
Ensure that the hole is completely covered by Matrigel.
Allow Matrigel to solidify while preparing HFK.
Seed keratinocytes at the air-liquid interface.
Trypsinize engineered and parental HFK.
Inactivate trypsin by adding equal volume of E medium.
Transfer cells to conical tube.
Centrifuge cells for 4 min at 290 RCF.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL E medium.
Prepare one 15 mL tube of cells for each raft culture to be established.
For each organotypic culture on an 0.5 cm² organotypic culture stand, aliquot 5 × 10⁵ parental HFK into a fresh 15 mL conical tube.
Add the appropriate GFP-labeled HFK to each tube at the correct ratio.
Mix cells gently but thoroughly.
Centrifuge cells for 4 min at 290 RCF.
Aspirate the media from the keratinocyte pellets, removing as much of the media as possible without disturbing the pellets.
When the Matrigel is set, flip the 6 cm dishes containing the organotypic culture stands right side up.
Resuspend the keratinocyte pellets in 40 μL of E medium.
Seed all of the suspension in the center of the basement membrane side of the dermis on the organotypic culture stand.
Fill the plate surrounding the stand with E media until it just touches the bottom of the stand (around 3 mL).
Replace the media every 2–3 days.
Monitor the cultures for growth.
Trim organotypic cultures using a clean 15 cm plate as a cutting surface.
Remove portions of the dermis that contain no epithelium.
Optional: Add a thin layer of neutral buffered formalin into the bottom of a clean 6 cm dish (approximately 1 mL).
Place the trimmed organotypic culture in this dish.
Tilt and submerge the organotypic culture into the formalin with forceps.
Ensure the culture is lying flat.
Leave the dish undisturbed at room temperature for 10 min.
Place the trimmed organotypic culture in excess neutral buffer formalin—one jar per culture.
If an optional pre-fixation step was used, transfer the culture to a larger jar now.
Place in a dark, room temperature place for 24 h.
Dehydrate tissues in 70% ethanol.
Embed dehydrated tissues in paraffin.
Cut sections onto slides.
Deparaffinize tissue sections by placing slides at 55°C until paraffin wax becomes clear (around 30 min–1 h).
Remove the paraffin from the slides by incubating the slides in a wash series.
Wash slides 5 times with water.
Heat-induced epitope retrieval: Fill a polypropylene coplin jar with Sodium Citrate antigen retrieval buffer.
Place the filled jar in the bowl of a pressure cooker, adding 1–2 cm of water around the jar.
Preheat the pressure cooker until the water inside comes to a boil.
Stop the pressure cooker and release the pressure.
Place the slides in the coplin jar containing the antigen retrieval buffer.
Restart the pressure cooker and allow to incubate for 10 min after coming up to pressure.
Release the pressure from the pressure cooker.
Remove the jar with slides from the pressure cooker and place it into a wet ice bath.
Allow the jar and slides to cool for 15 min.
Block the slides.
Remove the slides one at a time from the cooled coplin jar.
Tap the side of each slide gently on a paper towel to remove any residual liquid.
Draw a border around the tissue sections using a PAP pen.
Wash the tissues with 100–200 μL of 0.05% TWEEN 20 in PBS.
Aspirate the wash buffer and replace it with histology blocking buffer spiked with 10% goat serum.
Incubate for 30-60 min.
Incubate the tissue sections in primary antibody.
Aspirate the blocking mixture.
Add 100–200 μL of primary antibody dilution to the tissue sections.
Incubate at 4°C overnight.
Incubate the tissue sections in secondary antibody.
Aspirate the primary antibody mixture from the tissues.
Wash the tissue sections with 0.05% TWEEN 20 in PBS three times for 5 min each.
Dilute secondary antibodies to blocking buffer spiked with 10% goat serum.
Add 100–200 μL of secondary antibody dilution to the tissue sections.
Incubate at room temperature for 1–2 h.
Wash the tissue sections with 0.05% TWEEN 20 in PBS three times for 5 min each.
Mount coverslips.
Add a drop of mounting media to the tissue section.
Slowly lower a cover slip onto the slide, taking care not to trap any bubbles.
Seal the coverslip to the slide with nail polish.
Image the organotypic culture tissue section using a fluorescent microscope.
Mix GFP-labeled cells with unmodified parental HFK at a dilution of 1:50.
Grow organotypic epithelial cultures from the mixed cell population.
Express HPV18 E7 in GFP-expressing cells using a retroviral vector.
Express the empty control vector (EV) in GFP-expressing cells for the control condition.
Record images covering the entire length of the organotypic culture section for quantification.
